Current principal findings. The microscopy series decomposes training history → parameters/numerical encoding → CoT → answer into an intervenable causal chain amenable to integration, Jacobians and SVD. The MRI series reconstructs whole-body terrain, history-to-CoT kernels, paired CoT/Answer kernels and the training sky in larger models and across more problems. VECTOR-CODE-009 shows that, with visible tokens, complete CoT, endpoints and the token0→token1 contrast vector fixed, orthogonal embedding directions can carry local control gains differing by hundreds of times and can change the final answer before changing the next discrete CoT bit. VECTOR-SUBSPACE-010 exactly separates a 4D embedding into readable Row(U) and silent Null(U), and separates lexical contrast from downstream control modes within the readable subspace. CONTROL-FLOW-011 shows that CoT states reweight input channels through the nonlinear derivative gate D_t, producing state-dependent rotation of the principal control direction as the chain advances. Together, these cases support treating CoT as history/state-conditioned computational actions: tokens change the current state and the controllable geometry of subsequent tokens. HISTORY-ALGEBRA-012 represents complete training histories as noncommutative ordered operator products. In the perturbative regime, six pairwise-order/Lie-commutator coordinates explain 98.792% of control-field differences across the 4! permutations of the same training multiset. TEACHER-DIMENSION-TRANSFER-013 tests whether low-dimensional control fields originate in the model or the training world. In a shared 10D ambient space, increasing teacher intrinsic control dimension from 1 to 6 yields median future-control r95 values of 1/2/3/4/5/6 in full-capacity students and 1/2/3/3/3/3 with a fixed rank-3 readable bottleneck. This supports dimension transfer in which the teacher supplies independent control degrees of freedom and the architecture sets the representational ceiling. DISCRETE-TEACHER-DIMENSION-014 transfers this experiment to fully discrete autoregressive tokens. With hard 0/1 CoT alone, mean student bit accuracy is approximately 99.10%; continuous control geometry varies, with additional directions at d=2/3 and compression to r95=5 at d=6. Adding pre-threshold numerical margins to the same visible tokens restores global control r95 to 1/2/3/4/5/6 in both initializations and returns an average 99.62% of control energy to the teacher causal subspace. This separates transferability of teacher control dimension from its identifiability through hard language traces. TRACE-CHANNEL-015 examines which traces identify this geometry. Across d=2/3/5 and two initializations, hard neighborhood samples and local counterfactual ordering yield variable recovery; a small amount of graded confidence substantially narrows the geometric equivalence class. At d=3, both hard-trained seeds have r95=4; quantizing margin magnitude into just 2 bins restores r95=3 in both. Finer confidence, signed margins and local numerical contexts further concentrate control energy in the teacher causal subspace.
The v1.4 language mathematics branch finds a low-rank language teacher field and represents linguistic units as state-dependent, noncommutative generative operators. Higher-level structures develop through ordered composition plus small, low-dimensional residual generators, forming Language Control Algebra v0.1.
The v1.5 reasoning-state branch defines reasoning states directly as response-equivalence classes under all allowed future control programs in a fully enumerable relational world. RESET restores the cursor to the same local position in 100% of cases and to the same reasoning state in 0%. STORE/RESET introduces a generator independent of lower-level relational motion. Correct action composition substantially outperforms reversed composition, supporting recursive noncommutative control over augmented relational states.
The v1.6 branch–compare–correct extension shows that BRANCH and counterfactual steps can change future-response states with the current committed answer held fixed. COMPARE writes a discrete gate and CORRECT conditionally rewrites the main trajectory using that gate. A mathematical comparison of LMs and a natural-reasoning reference algebra locates their distinction in predictive-state factorization and native control interfaces; both share computability.
The v1.7 reasoning-localization branch pauses autoregressive models at successive layers and time points with visible CoT strictly fixed. Hidden predictive states, state transplants and future-control tomography locate a functional reasoning locus and establish criteria separating decodable representations from reasoning states used by future control.
The model-scale branch establishes a measurable separation between representational capacity and local control: across 30 trained GRUs, larger width consistently increases the measured separation of different-answer states, and training coverage strongly predicts full-world accuracy. The integrated edition also incorporates two replication campaigns and their mathematical and data audits.
